atoms.text: Next, Tina is going to show you around some airports in the UK.

instruction.text: Answer Tina’s question by listening to the options and selecting the correct answer.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'>What is an airport?</voice>

b.sound: An airport is a place where planes take off and land.
An airport is a floating island in the sky.

instruction.text: Select the three images of airports in the UK.

feedback.finish: Correct! The UK has lots of airports spread around the whole country, but only a few of them fly to other countries.
feedback.wrong: This is a tropical island in the Caribbean.

instruction.text: This is Heathrow Airport in England. Select one of the seats to learn more.

feedback.end: Heathrow Airport is in London and is one of the busiest airports in the world! It has four terminals, each with lots of places where you can wait, eat and shop.

instruction.text: This is Manchester Airport in England. Select the plane to learn more.

feedback.end: This is the third busiest airport in the UK and flies to almost 200 different places. It also handles a lot of the cargo that arrives into the UK or needs to be flown abroad.

instruction.text: This is Sumburgh Airport in Scotland. Select the building to learn more.

feedback.end: Not all airports are big! Sumburgh Airport is on the Scottish island of Shetland, and planes mainly fly here from other Scottish airports.

instruction.text: Answer Tina’s question by listening to the options and selecting the correct answer.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>What is an international airport?</prosody></voice>

b.sound: An airport where planes can fly from here to other countries.
An airport that is in the middle of the ocean.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>What is a domestic airport?</prosody></voice>

b.sound: An airport where planes only fly to other airports in the same country.
An airport that is inside someone’s house.

feedback.end: Great! Large countries such as the USA have lots of domestic airports to help people get around. Many small countries often only have an international airport, such as the Caribbean island of Barbados.
feedback.sound: Great! Large countries such as the USA have lots of domestic airports to help people get around. Many small countries often only have an international airport, such as the Caribbean island of Barbados.

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Tina wants to learn more about the flights from Manchester Airport. Answer her question.

feedback.correct1: We can use a notepad and a pen to write down the information we learn.

atoms.a: “What tool might be useful for our fieldwork?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>What tool might be useful for our fieldwork?</prosody></voice>

instruction.text: This is a flight information board. Answer Tina’s questions.

atoms.a: “How many flights are there between 12pm and 1pm?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>How many flights are there between 12pm and 1pm?</prosody></voice>
ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>How many flights are currently boarding?</prosody></voice>

atoms.a: “Which gate should people going to Paris board at?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>Which gate should people going to Paris board at?</prosody></voice>

atoms.a: “What should people going to Faro do right now?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>What should people going to Fahro do right now?</prosody></voice>

feedback.end: Knowing how to read information boards is an important part of every journey! It also helps you learn a lot more about other flights and places in the world.
